narrative.overview: Operate-mode comparison interface. Typography and combinable colour roles support explicit restoration decisions; neutral surrounds protect the film image.

rules.name: Green follows confirmation
rules.body: Pipeline selection is a green method row and text label after server confirmation, never optimistic success.

rules.name: No decorative film changes
rules.body: Never tint or crossfade film pixels as interface feedback.

donts: Duplicate method help on hover and info buttons
Use colour as the only state identifier
